A '''tarpoon''' was a weapon used by many [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[hunting/Legends|hunters]].

It was a combination of a spear and a trident; its head was a trio of barbed blades, while the other end was attached to [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]] strand 20 [[meter/Legends|meters]] long. It was thrown to a prey, and then pulled to bring it close to the hunter, who then finished it off with their own [[Claw/Legends|claws]]. 

When the prey was too large and strong, sometimes the hunter "rode the prey", actually dragged by it.
